errors.text: The proposed alloy systems and precipitation route do not reconstruct the Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic FCC/B2 alloy or its high-pressure/high-temperature treatment.
The hypothesis omits the decisive 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h processing condition and the resulting hierarchical coherent-interface microstructure.
Its precipitation-hardening mechanism is fundamentally different from the target mechanism of coherent-interface-mediated dislocation transfer and activation of multiple deformation modes.
Evidence from a specific W-Ni-Fe-Ta precipitation-strengthened alloy is extrapolated to generic refractory multi-principal element alloys without direct validation.
